_about: Reel speed tips from Steam players, shown in the app as unverified player tips (Jude chose to use them, 2026-10-24; no credible source publishes a speed per lure or fish). Read from search-engine previews of the posts because steamcommunity.com is blocked from the cloud session. A tip applies to its lures, retrieves and fish; a missing key means any.

tips.text: Use Constant at 1x for spinners, spoons and similar lures.
Constant is "1x only really"; higher speeds are for Stop and Go or Twitching.
Speed 3 is for Stop and Go or Twitching, which slow the lure down, not for Constant.
Fishes spinners at 3x, then drops to 2x or 1x when a fish chases.

source.title: Steam discussion: Issues with reeling speed while using Lures

tips.text: Anything over 1x is often too fast for a fish to catch the lure, though catches at 2x happen.

source.title: Steam discussion: Sometimes fish can't catch up to reeling speed

tips.text: A size 3/0 crankbait at speed 4 (drag 40–45%) ran about 16 m deep and a sturgeon followed it.
A size 5 spoon at speed 3 near the surface caught several salmon (the post doesn't say which species).
Caught a Northern Pike on Constant at speed 4 from the lake shore in daytime (lure not stated).

tips.text: Caught a pike on Stop and Go at speed 2 (lure not stated).
